Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Νικόλαος ο Νεομάρτυρας ο εξ Ιχθύος της Κορινθίας», with the rank words left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 februarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Nicolae din Corint»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Νικόλαος ο Νεομάρτυρας ο εξ Ιχθύος της Κορινθίας»

attestations.note: The day's line calls him «ο εξ Ιχθύος της Κορινθίας», of Ichthys in Corinthia; the life page says the village was Psari of Corinthia. It puts his head at the monastery of the Great Meteoron and says a service for him was written by the hieromonk Damaskenos, later bishop of Lite and Rendina.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Έτσι τον έριξαν πρώτα στην πυρά και ύστερα τον αποκεφάλισαν. Ήταν το έτος 1554 μ.Χ.», and the page heads him «(; - 1554)». It sets the arrest under Suleiman I, «επί της βασιλείας του σουλτάνου Σουλεϊμάν Α' (1520 - 1566)», which contains that year.
